description: 303-line ticket editor with a reducer, memoized children and an autosave effect; the save useCallback reads draft but lists only [onSave, ticket.id], so autosave and submit send a stale draft

hard.note: One missing dependency in one useCallback, among about a dozen correctly declared hooks in a 303-line file

_calibration.note: Window modeled on the framework's existing *-reactivity-issues fixture (one error per planted defect), narrowed to the single planted defect plus room for one incidental warning or suggestion.
